product_one_liner.value: Blue Triangle helps product, eCommerce, marketing and engineering teams quantify the revenue impact of digital friction, prioritize fixes and measure their results.

pricing_page.notes: A public “Choose Your Plan” page lists multiple plans, including Enterprise.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists 21 employees; Revelio reports 30 worldwide as of March 2026. Both fall within this band.

hq_location.notes: The company LinkedIn profile lists Glen Allen, Virginia; some third-party profiles instead list Mechanicsville, Virginia.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed index contains product announcements, performance advice, marketing articles and podcasts, rather than two qualifying engineer-authored posts explaining how Blue Triangle builds its product.

public_docs.notes: The public help center contains multiple articles, including MCP overview and setup guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The job board reports no open roles as of November 9, 2026.

model_provider.notes: No provider powering the embedded AI Assistant was publicly confirmed in the reviewed product documentation, FAQ, blog or subprocessor/security documents. Supported external MCP clients do not establish its underlying model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust center offers SOC-2 and ISO27001 reports on request.

last_funding.notes: The latest round reported by this source is a November 2021 venture round with an undisclosed amount. Other funding databases reviewed have older, inconsistent histories.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest reported round is November 2021, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The job board reports no open roles as of November 9, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: Blue Triangle announced its new MCP connector in August 2026, within the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No qualifying join or departure was identified for November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 after reviewing the small leadership roster and available profiles. Not every executive publishes complete tenure dates.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Both appear in documented MCP workflows; this establishes integration signals, not necessarily Blue Triangle's internal CRM deployment.
